focus: Truck-rental desks with Phoenix addresses (eight company-run U-Haul stores from Downtown, Arcadia, Biltmore, and Papago Park to West Phoenix and South Mountain, three U-Haul neighborhood dealers, and six Penske locations, including three Home Depot stores), plus three labor-only options
intro: This first Phoenix page covers truck-rental locations whose official U-Haul and Penske pages list a Phoenix address — eight company-run U-Haul stores that all publish Sunday hours and stay open until 7:00 PM most weekdays (8:00 PM Fridays), three U-Haul neighborhood dealers (one, WY Market on W Buckeye Rd, lists 8:00 AM–11:00 PM every day), and six Penske desks, including three Home Depot stores open until 7:30 PM every day. Three labor-only options are included for people who already have a truck or container: Bellhop, Cactus Valley Moving Labor & Help, and Budget Movers, two of which publish hourly rates. Budget Truck Rental, Enterprise Truck Rental, most U-Haul dealers, and nearby cities such as Tempe, Mesa, Scottsdale, Glendale, and Chandler are not covered yet. All eight company-run U-Haul stores list shortened Thanksgiving Day hours (7:00 AM–3:00 PM on November 26). We do not report live truck counts; one-way and cargo-van flags are on only when the location page itself mentions them.

listings.name: Bellhop — Phoenix hourly moving labor

hours.notes: Hours from the footer of the official Phoenix page: Mon–Sat 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST, Sun 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST. The page gives these times in Eastern time, not Arizona time (6:00 AM–8:00 PM in Phoenix while Arizona is on MST).

listings.offersNotes: The official Phoenix page offers “Hourly moving help and labor”: “If you don’t need transportation but could use some moving help, Bellhop’s skilled Phoenix movers make quick work of loading, unloading, and/or rearranging.” It says it can book with as little as one day’s notice and to call about same-day or next-day moves. The same page says Bellhop is a federally regulated property broker that connects customers with independent labor and/or transportation providers.
listings.visitNotes: Bellhop describes itself as a broker, so the crew may be a partner mover. Book online or by phone and confirm crew availability for your date.

sources.label: Bellhop Phoenix movers page

listings.name: Cactus Valley Moving Labor & Help

hours.notes: The official site does not publish office or crew hours. Call to check availability.

listings.offersNotes: The official site says the company specializes in moving labor: the customer provides the rental truck (U-Haul, Penske, etc.) or storage container and the crew loads or unloads it, including PODS, U-Box, ABF trailers, and Pack-Rat containers. It says the crew generally does not drive the customer’s rental truck.
listings.visitNotes: The site lists a second customer-service line, (520) 386-3147. Confirm crew availability for your date and time.
listings.feeNotes: Rates as listed on 2026-11-25 on the official site: $45 per hour per person — 2-person crew $90/hour, 3-person $135/hour, 4-person $180/hour, 5-person $225/hour — with a 2-hour minimum on all jobs. The site says same-day moves carry a 10% to 15% premium depending on availability and that final pricing depends on the day and crew availability.

sources.label: Cactus Valley Moving official site

listings.name: Budget Movers — loading and unloading

hours.notes: Hours from the official loading-and-unloading page: Mon–Fri 8 am–6 pm, Sat 9 am–2 pm, Sun closed. The page also lists a second office at 5455 N 51st Ave, Suite 35, Glendale, AZ 85301.

listings.offersNotes: The official page says the crew will load or unload rental trucks, storage containers, and more, and that customers can either use a rental truck they arranged or the company’s own 24-foot and 26-foot trucks.
listings.visitNotes: Quotes are tailored to the number of items, crew size, distance, and access. Confirm crew availability for your date.
listings.feeNotes: Loading and unloading as listed on 2026-11-25 on the official page: “Starting from $115 per hour.” Final quotes depend on items, crew size, and access.
